# Ceridwen Business Solutions

> Beth Kukla is a PMP-certified business consultant and operations strategist based in Santa Cruz, CA. She helps small and mid-sized businesses improve processes, lead change, and implement technology.

## Services
- Strategic Planning: business strategy, goal alignment, roadmaps
- Operations & Process Improvement: workflow design, efficiency, systems
- Change Management: organizational change, team alignment
- Technology Implementation: AI tools, custom landing pages, software selection
